item.title: 🎂 Happy 4th Birthday — Celebrating Family First
item.description:
Today we pause the build to celebrate what matters most.
My grandson turns 4 years old on Friday, May 8th, 2026.
Four years of curiosity, energy, and pure joy. Every line of code, every late night, every build session — it is all for moments like this.
Family first. Always.
Happy Birthday. 🎂⚡

item.title: ANTCPU is Building — The Automation Hub is Live
item.description:
After months of quiet work, the automation hub is in active development and the feed is back.

Since January we have been heads down.

The feed went quiet — not because nothing was happening, but because everything was happening.

The automation hub is now in active development. Internal tools are live. APIs are connected. The build pipeline is running.

We are months away from major releases. Each one will get its own post right here.

This is the shift from marketing what we do to building what we market.

antcpu.com is becoming the automation fabric. Every tool. Every app. Every agent. Connected.

The feed is back — and it has a lot to say.
